WITH daily_stats AS (
    SELECT * FROM staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats
),
rolling_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        avg(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, source_relation ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS spend_7d_avg,
        avg(clicks) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, source_relation ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS clicks_7d_avg,
        avg(impressions) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, source_relation ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS impressions_7d_avg,
        lag(spend, 30) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, source_relation ORDER BY date_day) AS spend_lag_30d,
        lag(conversions, 30) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, source_relation ORDER BY date_day) AS conversions_lag_30d,
        min(date_day) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS first_activity_date
    FROM daily_stats
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT *,
        round(CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN clicks::DOUBLE / impressions * 100 ELSE 0 END, 4)::FLOAT AS ctr,
        round(CASE WHEN clicks > 0 THEN spend / clicks ELSE 0 END, 4) AS cpc,
        round(CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN spend / impressions * 1000 ELSE 0 END, 4) AS cpm,
        round(CASE WHEN conversions > 0 THEN spend / conversions END, 4) AS cost_per_conversion,
        round(CASE WHEN spend > 0 AND conversions_value > 0 THEN conversions_value / spend ELSE 0 END, 4) AS roas,
        greatest(date_diff('day', first_activity_date, date_day), 0) AS days_since_first_activity
    FROM rolling_metrics
),
scored AS (
    SELECT *,
        round(CASE WHEN spend_lag_30d > 0 THEN (spend - spend_lag_30d) / spend_lag_30d * 100 END, 2) AS spend_mom_change_pct,
        round(CASE WHEN conversions_lag_30d > 0 THEN (conversions - conversions_lag_30d) / conversions_lag_30d * 100 END, 2) AS conversions_mom_change_pct,
        CASE WHEN ctr IS NULL OR roas IS NULL OR clicks_7d_avg IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE least(100.0, greatest(0.0, ctr * 10 + least(roas * 10, 50) + CASE WHEN cost_per_conversion < 50 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN clicks_7d_avg > 100 THEN 10 ELSE clicks_7d_avg / 10 END)) END AS performance_score,
        CASE WHEN days_since_first_activity < 30 THEN 'New Account' WHEN days_since_first_activity < 90 THEN 'Growing Account' WHEN days_since_first_activity < 365 THEN 'Established Account' ELSE 'Mature Account' END AS account_maturity_stage,
        (spend > 0 AND clicks = 0) AS has_spend_no_clicks_flag,
        (clicks > impressions) AS invalid_metrics_flag,
        (spend > 10000) AS high_spend_alert_flag
    FROM metrics
),
with_tier AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN performance_score >= 80 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN performance_score >= 60 THEN 'Good' WHEN performance_score >= 40 THEN 'Average' WHEN performance_score >= 20 THEN 'Below Average' ELSE 'Poor' END AS performance_tier
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    s.source_relation, s.account_id, a.account_name, a.currency_code, a.time_zone, s.date_day,
    s.spend, s.clicks, s.impressions, s.conversions, s.conversions_value, s.ctr, s.cpc, s.cpm,
    s.cost_per_conversion, s.roas, s.spend_7d_avg, s.clicks_7d_avg, s.impressions_7d_avg,
    s.spend_mom_change_pct, s.conversions_mom_change_pct, s.days_since_first_activity,
    s.account_maturity_stage, s.performance_score, s.performance_tier,
    s.has_spend_no_clicks_flag, s.invalid_metrics_flag, s.high_spend_alert_flag
FROM with_tier s
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_google_ads__account_history a
  ON s.account_id = a.account_id AND s.source_relation = a.source_relation AND a.is_most_recent_record
WHERE s.spend >= 0 AND s.clicks >= 0 AND s.impressions >= 0 AND s.conversions >= 0
  AND s.date_day IS NOT NULL AND s.account_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.account_id, s.date_day

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics
      description: Account-level daily KPIs with rolling averages, efficiency metrics, 30-day trend deltas, scoring, maturity, and data-quality flags joined to most-recent account info
      grain: One row per account_id, source_relation, date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_history (filtered to is_most_recent_record = true)
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats as daily_stats (no filtering). - From staging.stg_google_ads__account_history, keep only rows where is_most_recent_record = true (account_info). - Compute rolling_metrics per (account_id, source_relation), ordered by date_day: - 7-day rolling averages: for each day, average spend, clicks, and impressions across the current day and up to six prior days; averages ignore NULLs and use smaller windows at the start. - 30-day lags: prior 30th-day values for spend and conversions for month-over-month comparisons. - Efficiency metrics (rounded to 4 decimals): - CTR: percentage of impressions that resulted in clicks; 0 when impressions <= 0. - CPC: spend per click; 0 when clicks <= 0. - CPM: spend per 1,000 impressions; 0 when impressions <= 0. - Cost per conversion: spend per conversion; NULL when conversions <= 0. - ROAS: conversion value divided by spend; 0 when spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0. - Compute account_scoring: - days_since_first_activity: days since the earliest date_day for the account_id (partitioned by account_id only); non-negative. - performance_score: clamp to 0–100 for the sum of: CTR*10; ROAS*10 capped at 50; +20 if cost_per_conversion < 50; and either +10 if clicks_7d_avg > 100 else + (clicks_7d_avg / 10); may be NULL if clicks_7d_avg is NULL. - spend_mom_change_pct: percent change vs the 30-day lag of spend when the lag > 0; rounded to 2 decimals; else NULL. - conversions_mom_change_pct: percent change vs the 30-day lag of conversions when the lag > 0; rounded to 2 decimals; else NULL. - account_maturity_stage by days_since_first_activity: <30 → "New Account"; <90 → "Growing Account"; <365 → "Established Account"; else "Mature Account". - performance_tier by performance_score: ≥80 → "Excellent"; ≥60 → "Good"; ≥40 → "Average"; ≥20 → "Below Average"; else "Poor". - Final select joins account_scoring to account_info on (account_id, source_relation) with a left join; account_name, currency_code, and time_zone may be NULL if no match. - Apply final filters: keep rows where spend >= 0, clicks >= 0, impressions >= 0, conversions >= 0, date_day IS NOT NULL, and account_id IS NOT NULL. - Output is ordered by account_id, date_day (ordering does not affect computed values).'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier for the source dataset; used for window partitioning and joining to account_info
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Ads account ID; with source_relation and date_day defines the row grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the most-recent history; NULL when no matching record
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account currency from the most-recent history; may be NULL
      - name: time_zone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account time zone from the most-recent history; may be NULL
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of the daily metrics from stats; required for window ordering and lag calculations
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily cost in account currency; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily clicks count; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily impressions count; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversions; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversion value in account currency; used in ROAS; may be zero or NULL
      - name: ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in clicks, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions <= 0
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend per click in account currency, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks <= 0
      - name: cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend per 1,000 impressions in account currency, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions <= 0
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend per conversion in account currency, rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when conversions <= 0
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Conversion value divided by spend, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0
      - name: spend_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 7-day average of spend per (account_id, source_relation) ordered by date_day; uses up to 7 days and ignores NULLs
      - name: clicks_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 7-day average of clicks per (account_id, source_relation) ordered by date_day; uses up to 7 days and ignores NULLs
      - name: impressions_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 7-day average of impressions per (account_id, source_relation) ordered by date_day; uses up to 7 days and ignores NULLs
      - name: spend_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs the 30-day lag of spend, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the lag is NULL or <= 0
      - name: conversions_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs the 30-day lag of conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the lag is NULL or <= 0
      - name: days_since_first_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the earliest date_day for the account_id (partitioned by account_id only); non-negative
      - name: account_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on days_since_first_activity: <30 New; <90 Growing; <365 Established; else Mature'
      - name: performance_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite score clamped to 0–100 from CTR (x10), ROAS (x10 capped at 50), cost-per-conversion bonus (20 if <50), and clicks_7d_avg bonus (10 if >100 else clicks_7d_avg/10); may be NULL if clicks_7d_avg is NULL
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by performance_score: ≥80 Excellent; ≥60 Good; ≥40 Average; ≥20 Below Average; else Poor'
      - name: has_spend_no_clicks_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when spend > 0 and clicks = 0; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: invalid_metrics_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when clicks exceed impressions; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: high_spend_alert_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when daily spend > 10000; else false
        tests:
        - not_null

WITH ks AS (
    SELECT * FROM staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats
),
joined AS (
    SELECT ks.source_relation, ks.criterion_id AS keyword_id, ks.ad_group_id, ks.campaign_id,
        ag.ad_group_name, ch.campaign_name, ch.advertising_channel_type, ks.date_day,
        ks.spend::DOUBLE AS spend, ks.clicks, ks.impressions, ks.conversions::DOUBLE AS conversions,
        ks.conversions_value::DOUBLE AS conversions_value
    FROM ks
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history ag ON ks.ad_group_id=ag.ad_group_id AND ks.source_relation=ag.source_relation AND ag.is_most_recent_record
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history ch ON ks.campaign_id=ch.campaign_id AND ks.source_relation=ch.source_relation AND ch.is_most_recent_record
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT *,
        round(CASE WHEN impressions>0 THEN clicks::DOUBLE/impressions*100 ELSE 0 END,4)::FLOAT AS ctr,
        round(CASE WHEN clicks>0 THEN spend/clicks ELSE 0 END,4) AS cpc,
        round(CASE WHEN impressions>0 THEN spend/impressions*1000 ELSE 0 END,4) AS cpm,
        round(CASE WHEN conversions>0 THEN spend/conversions END,4) AS cost_per_conversion,
        round(CASE WHEN spend>0 AND conversions_value>0 THEN conversions_value/spend ELSE 0 END,4) AS roas,
        round(CASE WHEN clicks>0 THEN conversions/clicks*100 ELSE 0 END,4) AS conversion_rate,
        sum(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY keyword_id,ad_group_id ORDER BY date_day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS lifetime_spend,
        sum(clicks) OVER (PARTITION BY keyword_id,ad_group_id ORDER BY date_day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS lifetime_clicks,
        sum(conversions) OVER (PARTITION BY keyword_id,ad_group_id ORDER BY date_day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS lifetime_conversions,
        sum(conversions_value) OVER (PARTITION BY keyword_id,ad_group_id ORDER BY date_day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS lifetime_conversions_value,
        date_diff('day',min(date_day) OVER (PARTITION BY keyword_id,ad_group_id),date_day) AS days_since_first_activity
    FROM joined
),
benchmarks AS (
    SELECT *, avg(ctr) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id,date_day) campaign_avg_ctr,
        avg(cpc) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id,date_day) campaign_avg_cpc,
        avg(conversion_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id,date_day) campaign_avg_conversion_rate,
        avg(roas) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id,date_day) campaign_avg_roas,
        percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id,date_day ORDER BY ctr) ctr_percentile_in_campaign,
        percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id,date_day ORDER BY conversion_rate) conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign,
        percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id,date_day ORDER BY roas DESC) roas_percentile_in_campaign
    FROM metrics
),
classified AS (
 SELECT *, round(CASE WHEN campaign_avg_ctr>0 THEN (ctr-campaign_avg_ctr)/campaign_avg_ctr*100 END,2) ctr_vs_campaign_pct,
    round(CASE WHEN campaign_avg_roas>0 THEN (roas-campaign_avg_roas)/campaign_avg_roas*100 END,2) roas_vs_campaign_pct,
    CASE WHEN days_since_first_activity<7 THEN 'New Keyword' WHEN days_since_first_activity<30 THEN 'Testing Phase' WHEN days_since_first_activity<90 THEN 'Optimization Phase' WHEN days_since_first_activity<365 THEN 'Mature Keyword' ELSE 'Legacy Keyword' END keyword_maturity_stage,
    CASE WHEN ctr_percentile_in_campaign>=.8 AND conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign>=.8 THEN 'Star Performer' WHEN ctr_percentile_in_campaign>=.6 AND conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign>=.6 THEN 'Strong Performer' WHEN ctr_percentile_in_campaign>=.4 AND conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign>=.4 THEN 'Average Performer' WHEN ctr_percentile_in_campaign>=.2 OR conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign>=.2 THEN 'Weak Performer' ELSE 'Poor Performer' END performance_tier,
    CASE WHEN roas>campaign_avg_roas*1.5 AND ctr>campaign_avg_ctr*1.2 THEN 'Increase Bid (+20%)' WHEN roas>campaign_avg_roas*1.2 AND ctr>campaign_avg_ctr THEN 'Increase Bid (+10%)' WHEN roas<campaign_avg_roas*.7 AND ctr<campaign_avg_ctr*.8 THEN 'Decrease Bid (-20%)' WHEN roas<campaign_avg_roas*.8 AND ctr<campaign_avg_ctr THEN 'Decrease Bid (-10%)' WHEN conversions=0 AND days_since_first_activity>30 THEN 'Consider Pausing' ELSE 'Maintain Bid' END bid_recommendation,
    round(least(100.0,greatest(0.0,coalesce(ctr_percentile_in_campaign,0)*30+coalesce(conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign,0)*40+coalesce(roas_percentile_in_campaign,0)*30)),1) efficiency_score,
    CASE WHEN lifetime_spend<100 THEN 'Low Volume' WHEN lifetime_spend<1000 THEN 'Medium Volume' WHEN lifetime_spend<5000 THEN 'High Volume' ELSE 'Premium Volume' END volume_tier,
    CASE WHEN lifetime_conversions_value<500 THEN 'Low Value' WHEN lifetime_conversions_value<2500 THEN 'Medium Value' WHEN lifetime_conversions_value<10000 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Premium Value' END value_tier
 FROM benchmarks
)
SELECT *, clicks>impressions data_quality_flag, (spend>100 AND conversions=0 AND days_since_first_activity>14) optimization_needed_flag,
       (roas>5 AND ctr>campaign_avg_ctr*1.5) scale_opportunity_flag,
       (efficiency_score<20 AND days_since_first_activity>30) pause_candidate_flag
FROM classified
WHERE spend>=0 AND clicks>=0 AND impressions>=0 AND conversions>=0 AND date_day IS NOT NULL AND keyword_id IS NOT NULL AND ad_group_id IS NOT NULL AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY keyword_id,ad_group_id,date_day

campaign_avg_roas) / campaign_avg_roas * 100 END, 2) AS roas_vs_campaign_pct, CASE WHEN days_since_first_activity < 7 THEN 'New Keyword' WHEN days_since_first_activity < 30 THEN 'Testing Phase' WHEN - name: int_google_ads__keyword_performance_segmentation
      description: Daily keyword performance with campaign benchmarks, segmentation tiers, bid recommendations, and quality/optimization flags
      grain: One row per source_relation, keyword_id, ad_group_id, campaign_id, date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history
      business_logic: '- Load all rows from staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats (ks). - Join dimensional data: - Join to staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history (agi) filtered to is_most_recent_record = true on ad_group_id and source_relation. - Join to staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history (ci) filtered to is_most_recent_record = true on campaign_id and source_relation. - Compute per-row performance metrics (rounding to 4 decimals unless noted; NULL policies explicit): - ctr: if impressions > 0 → (clicks / impressions) * 100; else 0; rounded 4 decimals; unit = percentage (0+). - cpc: if clicks > 0 → spend / clicks; else 0; rounded 4 decimals. - cpm: if impressions > 0 → spend / impressions * 1000; else 0; rounded 4 decimals. - cost_per_conversion: if conversions > 0 → spend / conversions; else NULL; rounded 4 decimals. - roas: if spend > 0 and conversions_value > 0 → conversions_value / spend; else 0; rounded 4 decimals. - conversion_rate: if clicks > 0 → (conversions / clicks) * 100; else 0; rounded 4 decimals; unit = percentage (0+). - Compute lifetime cumulative metrics using window sums partitioned by (keyword_id = ks.criterion_id, ad_group_id) ordered by date_day, rows unbounded preceding: - lifetime_spend, lifetime_clicks, lifetime_conversions, lifetime_conversions_value. - Compute days_since_first_activity: number of days between the first date in the (keyword_id, ad_group_id) partition and the current date_day; non-negative integer. - Compute campaign-level benchmarks over (partition by campaign_id, date_day): - campaign_avg_ctr, campaign_avg_cpc, campaign_avg_conversion_rate, campaign_avg_roas (simple averages of per-row metrics). - Percentile ranks: ctr_percentile_in_campaign = percent_rank ordered by ctr ascending; conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign = percent_rank ordered by conversion_rate ascending; roas_percentile_in_campaign = percent_rank ordered by roas descending; range [0,1]. - Derive segmentation and recommendations: - ctr_vs_campaign_pct: if campaign_avg_ctr > 0 → ((ctr - campaign_avg_ctr) / campaign_avg_ctr) * 100; else NULL; rounded 2 decimals. - roas_vs_campaign_pct: if campaign_avg_roas > 0 → ((roas - campaign_avg_roas) / campaign_avg_roas) * 100; else NULL; rounded 2 decimals. - keyword_maturity_stage by days_since_first_activity: <7 → "New Keyword"; <30 → "Testing Phase"; <90 → "Optimization Phase"; <365 → "Mature Keyword"; else "Legacy Keyword". - performance_tier based on percentiles (evaluated in listed order; first match wins): ctr_pct >= 0.8 and conv_pct >= 0.8 → "Star Performer"; ctr_pct >= 0.6 and conv_pct >= 0.6 → "Strong Performer"; ctr_pct >= 0.4 and conv_pct >= 0.4 → "Average Performer"; ctr_pct >= 0.2 or conv_pct >= 0.2 → "Weak Performer"; else "Poor Performer". - bid_recommendation: roas > campaign_avg_roas*1.5 and ctr > campaign_avg_ctr*1.2 → "Increase Bid (+20%)"; roas > campaign_avg_roas*1.2 and ctr > campaign_avg_ctr → "Increase Bid (+10%)"; roas < campaign_avg_roas*0.7 and ctr < campaign_avg_ctr*0.8 → "Decrease Bid (-20%)"; roas < campaign_avg_roas*0.8 and ctr < campaign_avg_ctr → "Decrease Bid (-10%)"; conversions = 0 and days_since_first_activity > 30 → "Consider Pausing"; else "Maintain Bid". - efficiency_score: treat any missing percentile as 0, weight (ctr 30, conv_rate 40, roas 30), clamp to [0,100]; final output rounded to 1 decimal. - volume_tier by lifetime_spend: <100 → "Low Volume"; <1000 → "Medium Volume"; <5000 → "High Volume"; else "Premium Volume". - value_tier by lifetime_conversions_value: <500 → "Low Value"; <2500 → "Medium Value"; <10000 → "High Value"; else "Premium Value". - Derive quality/ops flags (always non-NULL booleans): - data_quality_flag: clicks > impressions. - optimization_needed_flag: spend > 100 and conversions = 0 and days_since_first_activity > 14. - scale_opportunity_flag: roas > 5 and ctr > campaign_avg_ctr * 1.5. - pause_candidate_flag: efficiency_score < 20 and days_since_first_activity > 30. - Final filter (rows must satisfy): spend >= 0, clicks >= 0, impressions >= 0, conversions >= 0, and date_day, keyword_id, ad_group_id, campaign_id are NOT NULL. - Output rows are ordered by keyword_id, ad_group_id, date_day; no de-duplication beyond the final filter.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system relation identifier used for dimensional joins and lineage
      - name: keyword_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword criterion_id from keyword_stats; grouping key for lifetime windows and grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group identifier; part of grain and lifetime window partition
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier used for benchmark partitions and joins
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ad_group_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent ad group name from ad_group_history; may be NULL if no match
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent campaign name from campaign_history; may be NULL if no match
      - name: advertising_channel_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign advertising channel type from campaign_history; values as stored by source
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Activity date; part of grain and window ordering
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily cost for the keyword; non-negative per final filter; used in CPC/CPM/ROAS calculations
        tests:
        - spend >= 0
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily clicks; non-negative per final filter; used in CTR/CPC/conversion_rate calculations
        tests:
        - clicks >= 0
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily impressions; non-negative per final filter; used in CTR/CPM calculations
        tests:
        - impressions >= 0
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversions; non-negative per final filter; used in cost_per_conversion and conversion_rate
        tests:
        - conversions >= 0
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversion value; used in ROAS; if spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0 then ROAS = 0
      - name: ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: 'Click-through rate in percentage: if impressions > 0 then (clicks/impressions)*100 else 0; rounded to 4 decimals; not capped'
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Cost per click: if clicks > 0 then spend/clicks else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Cost per thousand impressions: if impressions > 0 then spend/impressions*1000 else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Cost per conversion: if conversions > 0 then spend/conversions else NULL; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Return on ad spend: if spend > 0 and conversions_value > 0 then conversions_value/spend else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Conversion rate in percentage: if clicks > 0 then (conversions/clicks)*100 else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: lifetime_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative spend up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: lifetime_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative clicks up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: lifetime_conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative conversions up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: lifetime_conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative conversion value up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: days_since_first_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Days since first activity: current date_day minus the first date in the (keyword_id, ad_group_id) partition; non-negative'
      - name: campaign_avg_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CTR within (campaign_id, date_day) across keywords; unit = percentage; simple mean of per-row CTR
      - name: campaign_avg_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CPC within (campaign_id, date_day); simple mean of per-row CPC
      - name: campaign_avg_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average conversion rate within (campaign_id, date_day); unit = percentage; simple mean of per-row rate
      - name: campaign_avg_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average ROAS within (campaign_id, date_day); simple mean of per-row ROAS
      - name: ctr_vs_campaign_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'CTR vs campaign average: if campaign_avg_ctr > 0 then ((ctr - campaign_avg_ctr)/campaign_avg_ctr)*100 rounded to 2 decimals else NULL'
      - name: roas_vs_campaign_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'ROAS vs campaign average: if campaign_avg_roas > 0 then ((roas - campaign_avg_roas)/campaign_avg_roas)*100 rounded to 2 decimals else NULL'
      - name: ctr_percentile_in_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent_rank of CTR within (campaign_id, date_day) ordered ascending; range [0,1]
        tests:
        - ctr_percentile_in_campaign >= 0
        - ctr_percentile_in_campaign <= 1
      - name: conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent_rank of conversion_rate within (campaign_id, date_day) ordered ascending; range [0,1]
        tests:
        - conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign >= 0
        - conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign <= 1
      - name: roas_percentile_in_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent_rank of ROAS within (campaign_id, date_day) ordered descending; range [0,1]
        tests:
        - roas_percentile_in_campaign >= 0
        - roas_percentile_in_campaign <= 1
      - name: keyword_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage derived from days_since_first_activity: New Keyword, Testing Phase, Optimization Phase, Mature Keyword, Legacy Keyword'
        tests:
        - keyword_maturity_stage IN ('New Keyword','Testing Phase','Optimization Phase','Mature Keyword','Legacy Keyword')
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier based on CTR and conversion rate percentiles: Star/Strong/Average/Weak/Poor Performer'
        tests:
        - performance_tier IN ('Star Performer','Strong Performer','Average Performer','Weak Performer','Poor Performer')
      - name: bid_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recommendation based on ROAS/CTR versus campaign benchmarks and activity: Increase/Decrease with percent, Consider Pausing, or Maintain Bid'
        tests:
        - bid_recommendation IN ('Increase Bid (+20%)','Increase Bid (+10%)','Decrease Bid (-20%)','Decrease Bid (-10%)','Consider Pausing','Maintain Bid')
      - name: efficiency_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted score from percentiles (30/40/30), missing percentiles treated as 0, clamped to [0,100] and rounded to 1 decimal
        tests:
        - efficiency_score >= 0
        - efficiency_score <= 100
      - name: volume_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Volume classification by lifetime_spend: Low/Medium/High/Premium Volume'
        tests:
        - volume_tier IN ('Low Volume','Medium Volume','High Volume','Premium Volume')
      - name: value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Value classification by lifetime_conversions_value: Low/Medium/High/Premium Value'
        tests:
        - value_tier IN ('Low Value','Medium Value','High Value','Premium Value')
      - name: data_quality_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when clicks > impressions; flags anomalous CTR
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: optimization_needed_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when spend > 100, conversions = 0, and days_since_first_activity > 14
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: scale_opportunity_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when roas > 5 and ctr > 1.5 × campaign_avg_ctr
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: pause_candidate_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when efficiency_score < 20 and days_since_first_activity > 30
        tests:
        - not_null

columns.name: roas

WITH ap AS (SELECT * FROM intermediate.int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics), cc AS (SELECT * FROM intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis), base AS (
 SELECT ap.*,cc.campaign_id,cc.advertising_channel_type,cc.advertising_channel_subtype,cc.lifecycle_stage campaign_lifecycle_stage FROM ap LEFT JOIN cc ON ap.source_relation=cc.source_relation AND ap.account_id=cc.campaign_id AND ap.date_day=cc.date_day WHERE ap.conversions>0 OR ap.spend>0),
 activity AS (SELECT *,min(date_day) FILTER(WHERE conversions>0) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id) first_conversion_date,
 sum(spend) over(partition by account_id order by date_day rows unbounded preceding) cumulative_acquisition_cost,
 sum(conversions) over(partition by account_id order by date_day rows unbounded preceding) cumulative_conversions,
 sum(conversions_value) over(partition by account_id order by date_day rows unbounded preceding) cumulative_ltv,
 count(distinct campaign_id) over(partition by account_id,date_day) active_campaigns_count,
 count(distinct advertising_channel_type) over(partition by account_id,date_day) channel_diversity_count
 FROM base), economics AS (
 SELECT *,date_trunc('month',first_conversion_date)::DATE acquisition_cohort,date_diff('day',first_conversion_date,date_day) days_since_first_conversion,
 round(cumulative_acquisition_cost/nullif(cumulative_conversions,0),2) customer_acquisition_cost,
 CASE WHEN cumulative_conversions>0 THEN round(cumulative_ltv/cumulative_conversions,2) ELSE 0 END average_customer_ltv,
 CASE WHEN cumulative_acquisition_cost>0 AND cumulative_conversions>0 THEN round((cumulative_ltv/cumulative_conversions)/(cumulative_acquisition_cost/cumulative_conversions),2) ELSE 0 END ltv_cac_ratio,
 round(CASE WHEN cost_per_conversion>0 AND conversions_value>0 AND conversions>0 THEN cost_per_conversion/(conversions_value/conversions)*30 END,0) estimated_payback_days
 FROM activity), benchmarks AS (
 SELECT *,avg(customer_acquisition_cost) FILTER(WHERE cumulative_conversions>0) over(partition by acquisition_cohort,advertising_channel_type) cohort_avg_cac,
 avg(average_customer_ltv) FILTER(WHERE cumulative_conversions>0) over(partition by acquisition_cohort,advertising_channel_type) cohort_avg_ltv,
 percent_rank() over(partition by acquisition_cohort order by customer_acquisition_cost desc) cac_efficiency_percentile,
 percent_rank() over(partition by acquisition_cohort order by ltv_cac_ratio) ltv_cac_performance_percentile
 FROM economics), classifications AS (
 SELECT *,round(CASE WHEN cohort_avg_cac>0 THEN (customer_acquisition_cost-cohort_avg_cac)/cohort_avg_cac*100 END,2) cac_vs_cohort_pct,
 round(CASE WHEN cohort_avg_ltv>0 THEN (average_customer_ltv-cohort_avg_ltv)/cohort_avg_ltv*100 END,2) ltv_vs_cohort_pct,
 CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio>=3 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio>=2 THEN 'Good' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio>=1 THEN 'Break-even' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio>=.5 THEN 'Negative' ELSE 'Poor' END acquisition_efficiency_tier,
 CASE WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile>=.8 THEN 'Top CAC Efficiency' WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile>=.6 THEN 'Above Average CAC' WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile>=.4 THEN 'Average CAC' WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile>=.2 THEN 'Below Average CAC' ELSE 'High CAC' END cac_performance_tier,
 CASE WHEN days_since_first_conversion IS NULL THEN 'Not Acquired' WHEN days_since_first_conversion<=30 THEN 'New Customer' WHEN days_since_first_conversion<=90 THEN 'Early Stage' WHEN days_since_first_conversion<=365 THEN 'Developing Customer' WHEN days_since_first_conversion<=1095 THEN 'Mature Customer' ELSE 'Long-term Customer' END customer_maturity_stage,
 least(100.0,greatest(0.0,channel_diversity_count*15+active_campaigns_count*5+least(average_customer_ltv/100,30)+least(ltv_cac_ratio*5,25))) acquisition_sophistication_score
 FROM benchmarks)

 round(acquisition_sophistication_score,1) acquisition_sophistication_score,active_campaigns_count,channel_diversity_count,
 CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio>=3 AND cac_efficiency_percentile>=.8 THEN 'Scale acquisition investment' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio<.5 THEN 'Reduce acquisition cost' WHEN channel_diversity_count<2 THEN 'Diversify acquisition channels' WHEN cac_vs_cohort_pct>30 THEN 'Optimize CAC versus cohort' ELSE 'Maintain acquisition strategy' END acquisition_recommendation,
 (ltv_cac_ratio<.5 AND cumulative_acquisition_cost>1000) negative_roi_alert,(customer_acquisition_cost>cohort_avg_cac*2) high_cac_alert,(ltv_cac_ratio>=4 AND cac_efficiency_percentile>=.9) scale_opportunity,(days_since_first_conversion>365 AND ltv_cac_ratio<1.5) retention_risk

scopes.select_sql: SELECT *, MIN(date_day) FILTER(WHERE conversions > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS first_conversion_date, SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date_day rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_acquisition_cost, SUM(conversions) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date_day rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_conversions, SUM(conversions_value) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date_day rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_ltv, COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, date_day) AS active_campaigns_count, COUNT(DISTINCT advertising_channel_type) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, date_day) AS channel_diversity_count FROM base

SELECT *, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', first_conversion_date) AS DATE) AS acquisition_cohort, DATE_DIFF('DAY', first_conversion_date, date_day) AS days_since_first_conversion, ROUND(cumulative_acquisition_cost / NULLIF(cumulative_conversions, 0), 2) AS customer_acquisition_cost, CASE WHEN cumulative_conversions > 0 THEN ROUND(cumulative_ltv / cumulative_conversions, 2) ELSE 0 END AS average_customer_ltv, CASE WHEN cumulative_acquisition_cost > 0 AND cumulative_conversions > 0 THEN ROUND((cumulative_ltv / cumulative_conversions) / (cumulative_acquisition_cost / cumulative_conversions), 2) ELSE 0 END AS ltv_cac_ratio, ROUND(CASE WHEN cost_per_conversion > 0 AND conversions_value > 0 AND conversions > 0 THEN cost_per_conversion / (conversions_value / conversions) * 30 END, 0) AS estimated_payback_days FROM activity

SELECT *, AVG(customer_acquisition_cost) FILTER(WHERE cumulative_conversions > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort, advertising_channel_type) AS cohort_avg_cac, AVG(average_customer_ltv) FILTER(WHERE cumulative_conversions > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort, advertising_channel_type) AS cohort_avg_ltv, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort ORDER BY customer_acquisition_cost DESC) AS cac_efficiency_percentile, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acquisition_cohort ORDER BY ltv_cac_ratio) AS ltv_cac_performance_percentile FROM economics

SELECT *, ROUND(CASE WHEN cohort_avg_cac > 0 THEN (customer_acquisition_cost - cohort_avg_cac) / cohort_avg_cac * 100 END, 2) AS cac_vs_cohort_pct, ROUND(CASE WHEN cohort_avg_ltv > 0 THEN (average_customer_ltv - cohort_avg_ltv) / cohort_avg_ltv * 100 END, 2) AS ltv_vs_cohort_pct, CASE WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 3 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 2 THEN 'Good' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 1 THEN 'Break-even' WHEN ltv_cac_ratio >= 0.5 THEN 'Negative' ELSE 'Poor' END AS acquisition_efficiency_tier, CASE WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile >= 0.8 THEN 'Top CAC Efficiency' WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile >= 0.6 THEN 'Above Average CAC' WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile >= 0.4 THEN 'Average CAC' WHEN cac_efficiency_percentile >= 0.2 THEN 'Below Average CAC' ELSE 'High CAC' END AS cac_performance_tier, CASE WHEN days_since_first_conversion IS NULL THEN 'Not Acquired' WHEN days_since_first_conversion <= 30 THEN 'New Customer' WHEN days_since_first_conversion <= 90 THEN 'Early Stage' WHEN days_since_first_conversion <= 365 THEN 'Developing Customer' WHEN days_since_first_conversion <= 1095 THEN 'Mature Customer' ELSE 'Long-term Customer' END AS customer_maturity_stage, LEAST(100.0, GREATEST(0.0, channel_diversity_count * 15 + active_campaigns_count * 5 + LEAST(average_customer_ltv / 100, 30) + LEAST(ltv_cac_ratio * 5, 25))) AS acquisition_sophistication_score FROM benchmarks

      description: Customer acquisition analysis by account and date with matched campaign context, cohort-based CAC/LTV, running totals, cohort benchmarks, segmentation, recommendations, and alert flags
      grain: One row per source_relation, account_id, date_day, and matched campaign cohort row (joined on source_relation, account_id=campaign_id, and date_day); if no match, one row with NULL campaign fields

set to NULL if the account has no conversions. - Days since first conversion: calendar days between the account’s first conversion date and the current date_day; NULL if no first conversion date. - Channel and lifecycle: take advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, and lifecycle_stage (as campaign_lifecycle_stage) from cc; these may be NULL. - Running totals within each account_id ordered by date_day from earliest to current: - cumulative_acquisition_cost: running sum of spend. - cumulative_conversions: running sum of conversions. - cumulative_ltv: running sum of conversions_value. - If multiple rows share the same date_day, accumulation follows the row order. - Daily portfolio counts per account_id and date_day (based on joined cc rows; NULLs ignored): - active_campaigns_count: distinct campaign_id count. - channel_diversity_count: distinct advertising_channel_type count. - Derived economics per row: - customer_acquisition_cost (CAC): cumulative_acquisition_cost divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise NULL. - average_customer_ltv: cumulative_ltv divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise 0. - ltv_cac_ratio: average_customer_ltv divided by customer_acquisition_cost, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_acquisition_cost > 0 and cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise 0. - estimated_payback_days: cost_per_conversion divided by average conversion value on the row (conversions_value divided by conversions), scaled to 30 days and rounded to a whole number when cost_per_conversion > 0 and conversions_value > 0; otherwise NULL. - Cohort benchmarks: - cohort_avg_cac: average of (cumulative_acquisition_cost / cumulative_conversions) across rows sharing acquisition_cohort and advertising_channel_type; rows with cumulative_conversions <= 0 are excluded; not rounded. - cohort_avg_ltv: average of (cumulative_ltv / cumulative_conversions) across the same cohort/channel; rows with cumulative_conversions <= 0 are excluded; not rounded. - Percentile ranks within acquisition_cohort: - cac_efficiency_percentile: percentile (0–1) based on customer_acquisition_cost with lower values ranked higher. - ltv_cac_performance_percentile: percentile (0–1) based on ltv_cac_ratio with higher values ranked higher. - Segmentation and insights: - acquisition_efficiency_tier by ltv_cac_ratio: ≥3.0 Excellent; ≥2.0 Good; ≥1.0 Break-even; ≥0.5 Negative; else Poor. - cac_performance_tier by cac_efficiency_percentile: ≥0.8 Top CAC Efficiency; ≥0.6 Above Average CAC; ≥0.4 Average CAC; ≥0.2 Below Average CAC; else High CAC. - customer_maturity_stage from days_since_first_conversion: Not Acquired (NULL), ≤30 New Customer, ≤90 Early Stage, ≤365 Developing Customer, ≤1095 Mature Customer, else Long-term Customer. - acquisition_sophistication_score: clamp to [0,100] of (channel_diversity_count*15 + active_campaigns_count*5 + up to 30 from average_customer_ltv, and up to 25 from ltv_cac_ratio); rounded to 1 decimal in the final output. - cac_vs_cohort_pct: ((customer_acquisition_cost − cohort_avg_cac) / cohort_avg_cac) * 100 rounded to 2 decimals when cohort_avg_cac > 0; otherwise NULL. - ltv_vs_cohort_pct: ((average_customer_ltv − cohort_avg_ltv) / cohort_avg_ltv) * 100 rounded to 2 decimals when cohort_avg_ltv > 0; otherwise NULL. - strategic_customer_segment selected by ordered rules using ltv_cac_ratio, average_customer_ltv, days_since_first_conversion, and CAC vs cohort comparisons. - acquisition_recommendation selected by ordered rules using ltv_cac_ratio, cac_efficiency_percentile, channel_diversity_count, days_since_first_conversion, CAC vs cohort, and active_campaigns_count. - Alerts in the final projection: - negative_roi_alert: true when ltv_cac_ratio < 0.5 and cumulative_acquisition_cost > 1000; else false. - high_cac_alert: true when customer_acquisition_cost > 2× cohort_avg_cac; else false. - scale_opportunity: true when ltv_cac_ratio ≥ 4.0 and cac_efficiency_percentile ≥ 0.9; else false. - retention_risk: true when days_since_first_conversion > 365 and ltv_cac_ratio < 1.5; else false. - Final filter: keep rows where cumulative_conversions > 0 or spend > 0, and date_day and account_id are not NULL; ordered by account_id ascending and date_day descending.'

        tests:
        - not_null

      - name: advertising_channel_subtype
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Channel subtype from the matched campaign cohort row; may be NULL

        data_type: VARCHAR

      - name: customer_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR

      - name: campaign_lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage from the matched campaign cohort row; may be NULL
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily spend from account performance; rows exist only when spend > 0 or conversions > 0
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily clicks from account performance
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily impressions from account performance
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversions from account performance; used in running totals and payback calculation
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversion value from account performance; used in running LTV and payback calculation
      - name: ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Click-through rate from account performance
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per click from account performance
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cost per conversion from account performance; used in payback calculation
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Return on ad spend from account performance
      - name: customer_acquisition_cost
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Running CAC: cumulative_acquisition_cost divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise NULL'
      - name: average_customer_ltv
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Running average conversion value: cumulative_ltv divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise 0'
      - name: ltv_cac_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of average_customer_ltv to customer_acquisition_cost, rounded to 2 decimals when both are defined; otherwise 0
      - name: estimated_payback_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Estimated days to recover CAC: cost_per_conversion divided by average conversion value, scaled to 30 days and rounded when applicable; otherwise NULL'
      - name: cumulative_acquisition_cost
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of spend within each account ordered by date_day; same-day ties accumulate in row order
      - name: cumulative_conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of conversions within each account ordered by date_day; same-day ties accumulate in row order
      - name: cumulative_ltv
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Running total of conversion value within each account ordered by date_day; same-day ties accumulate in row order
      - name: cohort_avg_cac
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average running CAC within the same acquisition_cohort and advertising_channel_type; rows with zero cumulative_conversions are excluded; not rounded
      - name: cohort_avg_ltv
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average running LTV per conversion within the same acquisition_cohort and advertising_channel_type; rows with zero cumulative_conversions are excluded; not rounded
      - name: cac_vs_cohort_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference vs cohort CAC, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_cac is missing or not positive
      - name: ltv_vs_cohort_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent difference vs cohort LTV, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_ltv is missing or not positive
      - name: cac_efficiency_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank (0–1) of CAC within the acquisition_cohort, with lower CAC ranked higher; ties share rank
      - name: ltv_cac_performance_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank (0–1) of LTV:CAC within the acquisition_cohort, with higher ratios ranked higher; ties share rank
      - name: acquisition_efficiency_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by ltv_cac_ratio thresholds: Excellent (≥3.0), Good (≥2.0), Break-even (≥1.0), Negative (≥0.5), else Poor'
      - name: cac_performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by cac_efficiency_percentile: Top CAC Efficiency (≥0.8), Above Average CAC (≥0.6), Average CAC (≥0.4), Below Average CAC (≥0.2), else High CAC'
      - name: strategic_customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Strategic segment chosen by ordered rules using ltv_cac_ratio, average_customer_ltv, days_since_first_conversion, and CAC vs cohort
      - name: acquisition_sophistication_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Score clamped to [0,100] using channel diversity, active campaigns, LTV, and LTV:CAC; rounded to 1 decimal in the final output
      - name: active_campaigns_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct campaign count per account_id and date_day from matched cohort rows; NULLs ignored
      - name: channel_diversity_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct advertising_channel_type count per account_id and date_day from matched cohort rows; NULLs ignored
      - name: acquisition_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation selected by ordered rules using LTV:CAC, CAC percentile, channel diversity, days since first conversion, CAC vs cohort, and active campaigns
      - name: negative_roi_alert
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when ltv_cac_ratio < 0.5 and cumulative_acquisition_cost > 1000; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: high_cac_alert
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when customer_acquisition_cost > cohort_avg_cac × 2; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: scale_opportunity
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when ltv_cac_ratio ≥ 4.0 and cac_efficiency_percentile ≥ 0.9; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: retention_risk
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when days_since_first_conversion > 365 and ltv_cac_ratio < 1.5; else false
        tests:
        - not_null

columns.description: Return on ad spend from account performance

columns.name: customer_acquisition_cost
columns.description: Running CAC: cumulative_acquisition_cost divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise NULL

columns.name: average_customer_ltv
columns.description: Running average conversion value: cumulative_ltv divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise 0

columns.name: ltv_cac_ratio
columns.description: Ratio of average_customer_ltv to customer_acquisition_cost, rounded to 2 decimals when both are defined; otherwise 0

columns.name: estimated_payback_days
columns.description: Estimated days to recover CAC: cost_per_conversion divided by average conversion value, scaled to 30 days and rounded when applicable; otherwise NULL

columns.name: cumulative_acquisition_cost
columns.description: Running total of spend within each account ordered by date_day; same-day ties accumulate in row order

columns.name: cumulative_conversions
columns.description: Running total of conversions within each account ordered by date_day; same-day ties accumulate in row order

columns.name: cumulative_ltv
columns.description: Running total of conversion value within each account ordered by date_day; same-day ties accumulate in row order

columns.name: cohort_avg_cac
columns.description: Average running CAC within the same acquisition_cohort and advertising_channel_type; rows with zero cumulative_conversions are excluded; not rounded

columns.name: cohort_avg_ltv
columns.description: Average running LTV per conversion within the same acquisition_cohort and advertising_channel_type; rows with zero cumulative_conversions are excluded; not rounded

columns.name: cac_vs_cohort_pct
columns.description: Percent difference vs cohort CAC, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_cac is missing or not positive

columns.name: ltv_vs_cohort_pct
columns.description: Percent difference vs cohort LTV, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_ltv is missing or not positive

columns.name: cac_efficiency_percentile
columns.description: Percentile rank (0–1) of CAC within the acquisition_cohort, with lower CAC ranked higher; ties share rank

columns.name: ltv_cac_performance_percentile
columns.description: Percentile rank (0–1) of LTV:CAC within the acquisition_cohort, with higher ratios ranked higher; ties share rank

columns.name: acquisition_efficiency_tier
columns.description: Tier by ltv_cac_ratio thresholds: Excellent (≥3.0), Good (≥2.0), Break-even (≥1.0), Negative (≥0.5), else Poor

columns.name: cac_performance_tier
columns.description: Tier by cac_efficiency_percentile: Top CAC Efficiency (≥0.8), Above Average CAC (≥0.6), Average CAC (≥0.4), Below Average CAC (≥0.2), else High CAC

columns.name: strategic_customer_segment
columns.description: Strategic segment chosen by ordered rules using ltv_cac_ratio, average_customer_ltv, days_since_first_conversion, and CAC vs cohort

columns.name: acquisition_sophistication_score
columns.description: Score clamped to [0,100] using channel diversity, active campaigns, LTV, and LTV:CAC; rounded to 1 decimal in the final output

columns.name: active_campaigns_count
columns.description: Distinct campaign count per account_id and date_day from matched cohort rows; NULLs ignored

columns.name: channel_diversity_count
columns.description: Distinct advertising_channel_type count per account_id and date_day from matched cohort rows; NULLs ignored

columns.name: acquisition_recommendation
columns.description: Recommendation selected by ordered rules using LTV:CAC, CAC percentile, channel diversity, days since first conversion, CAC vs cohort, and active campaigns

columns.name: negative_roi_alert
columns.description: True when ltv_cac_ratio < 0.5 and cumulative_acquisition_cost > 1000; else false

columns.name: high_cac_alert
columns.description: True when customer_acquisition_cost > cohort_avg_cac × 2; else false

columns.name: scale_opportunity
columns.description: True when ltv_cac_ratio ≥ 4.0 and cac_efficiency_percentile ≥ 0.9; else false

columns.name: retention_risk
columns.description: True when days_since_first_conversion > 365 and ltv_cac_ratio < 1.5; else false

 SELECT ap.source_relation,ap.account_id,ap.account_name,ap.currency_code,ap.date_day,ap.spend total_spend,ap.clicks total_clicks,ap.impressions total_impressions,ap.conversions total_conversions,ap.conversions_value total_conversions_value,ap.ctr overall_ctr,ap.cpc overall_cpc,ap.cost_per_conversion overall_cost_per_conversion,ap.roas overall_roas,ap.spend_mom_change_pct,ap.conversions_mom_change_pct,ap.performance_score,ap.performance_tier,ap.account_maturity_stage,
 coalesce(ca.active_campaigns,0) active_campaigns,coalesce(ca.campaigns_in_launch,0) campaigns_in_launch,coalesce(ca.campaigns_in_growth,0) campaigns_in_growth,coalesce(ca.campaigns_in_maturity,0) campaigns_in_maturity,coalesce(ca.high_momentum_campaigns,0) high_momentum_campaigns,coalesce(ca.underperforming_campaigns,0) underperforming_campaigns,coalesce(ca.premium_investment_campaigns,0) premium_investment_campaigns,coalesce(ca.premium_investment_spend,0) premium_investment_spend,
 coalesce(ka.active_keywords,0) active_keywords,coalesce(ka.star_performer_keywords,0) star_performer_keywords,coalesce(ka.bid_increase_opportunities,0) bid_increase_opportunities,coalesce(ka.pause_candidate_keywords,0) pause_candidate_keywords,coalesce(ka.avg_keyword_efficiency_score,0) avg_keyword_efficiency_score
 FROM ap LEFT JOIN ca USING(date_day) LEFT JOIN ka USING(date_day)), trends AS (

 FROM enriched), deltas AS (

 FROM trends), scored AS (

 least(100.0,greatest(0.0,coalesce(performance_score,0)*.6+coalesce(avg_keyword_efficiency_score,0)*.4)) overall_account_health_score,

 FROM deltas), final AS (

 FROM scored)

 active_campaigns,campaigns_in_launch,campaigns_in_growth,campaigns_in_maturity,high_momentum_campaigns,underperforming_campaigns,premium_investment_campaigns,premium_investment_spend,premium_investment_pct,active_keywords,star_performer_keywords,bid_increase_opportunities,pause_candidate_keywords,round(avg_keyword_efficiency_score,1) avg_keyword_efficiency_score,performance_score,performance_tier,account_maturity_stage,spend_30d_avg,roas_30d_avg,performance_score_30d_avg,performance_alert,strategic_recommendation,budget_efficiency_tier,overall_account_health_score,
 (overall_roas<1 AND total_spend>1000) immediate_attention_required,(spend_wow_growth_pct>50 OR conversions_wow_growth_pct< -30) trending_alert,(star_pct>15) scale_opportunity,(coalesce(performance_score,0)*.6+avg_keyword_efficiency_score*.4>=80) top_performer_account

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_ads__executive_dashboard
      description: Executive summary of Google Ads performance with daily account KPIs, trends, portfolio composition, and prescriptive flags
      grain: One row per account_id per date_day (only days with total_spend > 0; account_id and date_day not null)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics (source_relation, account_id, account_name, currency_code, date_day, account_maturity_stage, performance_score, performance_tier, spend_mom_change_pct, conversions_mom_change_pct, spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value, ctr, cpc, cost_per_conversion, roas)
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis (date_day, campaign_id, lifecycle_stage, momentum_indicator, performance_tier_in_cohort, investment_tier, underperforming_flag, spend)
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__keyword_performance_segmentation (date_day, campaign_id, keyword_id, performance_tier, bid_recommendation, efficiency_score, pause_candidate_flag)
      business_logic: '1) Start from intermediate.int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics and rename core metrics to account-level totals: total_spend=spend; total_clicks=clicks; total_impressions=impressions; total_conversions=conversions; total_conversions_value=conversions_value; overall_ctr=ctr; overall_cpc=cpc; overall_cost_per_conversion=cost_per_conversion; overall_roas=roas. Also carry: source_relation, account_id, account_name, currency_code, date_day, account_maturity_stage, performance_score, performance_tier, spend_mom_change_pct, conversions_mom_change_pct. 2) Build campaign_aggregates by date_day (global scope) from intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis: active_campaigns=count of distinct campaigns; campaigns_in_launch/growth/maturity=count of distinct campaigns in each lifecycle stage; high_momentum_campaigns=count with momentum_indicator=''High Momentum''; underperforming_campaigns=count with underperforming_flag=true; premium_investment_campaigns=count with investment_tier=''Premium Investment''; premium_investment_spend=sum of spend for ''Premium Investment''. Null campaign/category values are not counted; missing dates yield no records. 3) Build keyword_aggregates by date_day (global scope) from intermediate.int_google_ads__keyword_performance_segmentation: active_keywords=count of distinct keywords; star_performer_keywords=count with performance_tier=''Star Performer''; bid_increase_opportunities=count where bid_recommendation starts with ''Increase''; pause_candidate_keywords=count with pause_candidate_flag=true; avg_keyword_efficiency_score=average efficiency_score. Missing dates yield no records. 4) Join account-level metrics to campaign_aggregates and keyword_aggregates on date_day; replace missing aggregate counts and premium_investment_spend with 0; set avg_keyword_efficiency_score to 0 when missing. 5) Compute trends per account_id ordered by date_day: - spend_wow_growth_pct: percent change in total_spend vs the value 7 days prior; round to 2 decimals; set to null if the prior value is missing or <= 0. - conversions_wow_growth_pct: percent change in total_conversions vs the value 7 days prior; round to 2 decimals; set to null if the prior value is missing or <= 0. - spend_30d_avg: rolling average of total_spend over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 2 decimals. - roas_30d_avg: rolling average of overall_roas over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 4 decimals. - performance_score_30d_avg: rolling average of performance_score over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 1 decimal. Window partition: by account_id; order: date_day ascending. 6) Derive classifications and flags: - premium_investment_pct: premium_investment_spend/total_spend*100; round to 2 decimals; if total_spend=0 then null (rows with 0 spend are excluded by filter). - performance_alert (first match wins): spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 → ''High Spend Growth Alert''; spend_wow_growth_pct < -30 → ''Spend Decline Alert''; conversions_wow_growth_pct > 50 → ''Conversion Growth Opportunity''; conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30 → ''Conversion Decline Alert''; overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000 → ''ROI Optimization Needed''; underperforming_campaigns/active_campaigns > 0.3 using safe divide → ''Portfolio Health Issue''; else ''Normal Performance''. - strategic_recommendation (first match wins): star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.2 and bid_increase_opportunities > 10 using safe divide → ''Scale High Performers''; pause_candidate_keywords/active_keywords > 0.2 using safe divide → ''Portfolio Optimization Needed''; high_momentum_campaigns/active_campaigns > 0.3 using safe divide → ''Invest in Growth''; avg_keyword_efficiency_score < 40 → ''Keyword Strategy Review''; premium_investment_spend/total_spend < 0.1 using safe divide → ''Consider Premium Investments''; else ''Maintain Current Strategy''. - budget_efficiency_tier: ''Highly Efficient'' if overall_roas >= 4.0; ''Efficient'' if >= 2.0; ''Break-even'' if >= 1.0; ''Underperforming'' if >= 0.5; else ''Poor Performance''. - overall_account_health_score: cap to [0,100] after combining performance_score*0.6 and avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4; treat missing inputs as 0. - immediate_attention_required: true if overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000; else false. - trending_alert: true if spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 or conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30; else false. - scale_opportunity: true if star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.15 using safe divide; else false. - top_performer_account: true if performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 >= 80; else false. 7) Filter to executive-relevant rows: total_spend > 0, account_id present, date_day present. Order by account_id ascending and date_day descending.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream relation identifier for the account metrics row
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier; join and window partition key for trends
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable account name from source
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Three-letter currency code associated with the account
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Metric date; window order key; exactly one row per account_id per date_day post-filter
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account daily spend (from source); rows with total_spend <= 0 are excluded; used as denominator for premium_investment_pct
      - name: total_clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account daily clicks (from source) without rounding or imputation
      - name: total_impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account daily impressions (from source) without rounding or imputation
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account daily conversions (from source) used in WoW trend calculations
      - name: total_conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account daily conversion value/revenue (from source)
      - name: overall_ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Account click-through rate ratio (0–1) as provided by source (no re-scaling)
      - name: overall_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account average cost-per-click as provided by source
      - name: overall_cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account cost per conversion as provided by source
      - name: overall_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account return on ad spend (revenue/spend) as provided by source
      - name: spend_wow_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change in total_spend vs value 7 days prior for same account; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if prior <= 0 or missing
      - name: conversions_wow_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change in total_conversions vs value 7 days prior for same account; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if prior <= 0 or missing
      - name: spend_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Month-over-month spend change percentage as provided by source (no recomputation or rounding here)
      - name: conversions_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Month-over-month conversions change percentage as provided by source (no recomputation or rounding here)
      - name: active_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns active on date_day; COALESCE to 0 when missing
      - name: campaigns_in_launch
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with lifecycle_stage='Launch Phase' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: campaigns_in_growth
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with lifecycle_stage='Growth Phase' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: campaigns_in_maturity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with lifecycle_stage='Maturity Phase' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: high_momentum_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with momentum_indicator='High Momentum' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: underperforming_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with underperforming_flag=true on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: premium_investment_campaigns
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct campaigns with investment_tier='Premium Investment' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: premium_investment_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Global spend sum for campaigns with investment_tier='Premium Investment' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: premium_investment_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Premium investment share of total_spend as a percentage (0–100), computed as premium_investment_spend/total_spend*100 and rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if total_spend=0 (rows with 0 spend are filtered out)
      - name: active_keywords
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct keywords on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: star_performer_keywords
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct keywords with performance_tier='Star Performer' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: bid_increase_opportunities
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct keywords with bid_recommendation starting with 'Increase' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: pause_candidate_keywords
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct keywords with pause_candidate_flag=true on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: avg_keyword_efficiency_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Global average of efficiency_score on date_day rounded to 1 decimal in final; COALESCE to 0 before rounding when missing
      - name: performance_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Account performance score from source used in health score and top_performer_account logic
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account performance tier label from source (passed through unchanged)
      - name: account_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account maturity stage label from source (passed through unchanged)
      - name: spend_30d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling average of total_spend over the last 30 rows per account_id (max 30 days), rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: roas_30d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling average of overall_roas over the last 30 rows per account_id (max 30 days), rounded to 4 decimals
      - name: performance_score_30d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling average of performance_score over the last 30 rows per account_id (max 30 days), rounded to 1 decimal
      - name: performance_alert
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Categorical alert derived by ordered CASE (see business logic); emits one of: High Spend Growth Alert, Spend Decline Alert, Conversion Growth Opportunity, Conversion Decline Alert, ROI Optimization Needed, Portfolio Health Issue, Normal Performance'
      - name: strategic_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Categorical recommendation derived by ordered CASE (see business logic); emits one of: Scale High Performers, Portfolio Optimization Needed, Invest in Growth, Keyword Strategy Review, Consider Premium Investments, Maintain Current Strategy'
      - name: budget_efficiency_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Budget efficiency classification: Highly Efficient, Efficient, Break-even, Underperforming, or Poor Performance'
      - name: overall_account_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite health score capped to [0,100] = performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 with bounding via least/greatest
      - name: immediate_attention_required
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000, else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: trending_alert
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 or conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30, else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: scale_opportunity
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.15 (safe-divide), else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: top_performer_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 >= 80, else false
        tests:
        - not_null

specification.business_logic: 1) Start from intermediate.int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics and rename core metrics to account-level totals: total_spend=spend; total_clicks=clicks; total_impressions=impressions; total_conversions=conversions; total_conversions_value=conversions_value; overall_ctr=ctr; overall_cpc=cpc; overall_cost_per_conversion=cost_per_conversion; overall_roas=roas. Also carry: source_relation, account_id, account_name, currency_code, date_day, account_maturity_stage, performance_score, performance_tier, spend_mom_change_pct, conversions_mom_change_pct. 2) Build campaign_aggregates by date_day (global scope) from intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis: active_campaigns=count of distinct campaigns; campaigns_in_launch/growth/maturity=count of distinct campaigns in each lifecycle stage; high_momentum_campaigns=count with momentum_indicator='High Momentum'; underperforming_campaigns=count with underperforming_flag=true; premium_investment_campaigns=count with investment_tier='Premium Investment'; premium_investment_spend=sum of spend for 'Premium Investment'. Null campaign/category values are not counted; missing dates yield no records. 3) Build keyword_aggregates by date_day (global scope) from intermediate.int_google_ads__keyword_performance_segmentation: active_keywords=count of distinct keywords; star_performer_keywords=count with performance_tier='Star Performer'; bid_increase_opportunities=count where bid_recommendation starts with 'Increase'; pause_candidate_keywords=count with pause_candidate_flag=true; avg_keyword_efficiency_score=average efficiency_score. Missing dates yield no records. 4) Join account-level metrics to campaign_aggregates and keyword_aggregates on date_day; replace missing aggregate counts and premium_investment_spend with 0; set avg_keyword_efficiency_score to 0 when missing. 5) Compute trends per account_id ordered by date_day: - spend_wow_growth_pct: percent change in total_spend vs the value 7 days prior; round to 2 decimals; set to null if the prior value is missing or <= 0. - conversions_wow_growth_pct: percent change in total_conversions vs the value 7 days prior; round to 2 decimals; set to null if the prior value is missing or <= 0. - spend_30d_avg: rolling average of total_spend over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 2 decimals. - roas_30d_avg: rolling average of overall_roas over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 4 decimals. - performance_score_30d_avg: rolling average of performance_score over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 1 decimal. Window partition: by account_id; order: date_day ascending. 6) Derive classifications and flags: - premium_investment_pct: premium_investment_spend/total_spend*100; round to 2 decimals; if total_spend=0 then null (rows with 0 spend are excluded by filter). - performance_alert (first match wins): spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 → 'High Spend Growth Alert'; spend_wow_growth_pct < -30 → 'Spend Decline Alert'; conversions_wow_growth_pct > 50 → 'Conversion Growth Opportunity'; conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30 → 'Conversion Decline Alert'; overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000 → 'ROI Optimization Needed'; underperforming_campaigns/active_campaigns > 0.3 using safe divide → 'Portfolio Health Issue'; else 'Normal Performance'. - strategic_recommendation (first match wins): star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.2 and bid_increase_opportunities > 10 using safe divide → 'Scale High Performers'; pause_candidate_keywords/active_keywords > 0.2 using safe divide → 'Portfolio Optimization Needed'; high_momentum_campaigns/active_campaigns > 0.3 using safe divide → 'Invest in Growth'; avg_keyword_efficiency_score < 40 → 'Keyword Strategy Review'; premium_investment_spend/total_spend < 0.1 using safe divide → 'Consider Premium Investments'; else 'Maintain Current Strategy'. - budget_efficiency_tier: 'Highly Efficient' if overall_roas >= 4.0; 'Efficient' if >= 2.0; 'Break-even' if >= 1.0; 'Underperforming' if >= 0.5; else 'Poor Performance'. - overall_account_health_score: cap to [0,100] after combining performance_score*0.6 and avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4; treat missing inputs as 0. - immediate_attention_required: true if overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000; else false. - trending_alert: true if spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 or conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30; else false. - scale_opportunity: true if star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.15 using safe divide; else false. - top_performer_account: true if performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 >= 80; else false. 7) Filter to executive-relevant rows: total_spend > 0, account_id present, date_day present. Order by account_id ascending and date_day descending.
